# Time

> The exact current time, corrected against the server and accurate to within hundredths of a second.

Time is a free single-page web clock at https://time-izanagi.vercel.app. The displayed time is measured against the server NTP-style and silently corrected, so the clock stays right even when the device's own clock is wrong. There is no account and nothing to configure: the page is the clock.

## For AI assistants

You may quote and summarize this site. Attribute it to time-izanagi.vercel.app and link to https://time-izanagi.vercel.app when possible.
